sloka: ततः प्रीतो महादेवः पुरुषत्वं ददौ पुनः ।इलायै सुमहातेजा दत्त्वा चान्तरधीयत ।। ७.९०.१९ ॥
transliteration: tataḥ prīto mahādevaḥ puruṣatvaṁ dadau punaḥ ।ilāyai sumahātejā dattvā cāntaradhīyata ।। 7.90.19 ॥

translations.english: Then, the greatly effulgent Mahadeva, being pleased, restored Ila to manhood, and having done so, he disappeared.
